strategy.reason: Weekend penalties are large and concentrated; block_reassign can move weekend assignments off over-limit nurses onto nurses with weekend capacity while potentially also repairing consecutive work/off patterns. Compared to block_swap, it can be guided to move coherent weekend blocks and reduce over-max totals for heavily loaded nurses (e.g., Stefaan/Nguyen) without needing complex cross-nurse shift-type exchanges.
strategy.avoid: Avoid block_swap patterns that previously triggered illegal_succession; also avoid coverage_fill since adding shifts risks increasing total_assignment_cost and worsening weekend overages for already heavily scheduled nurses.
